projects.title: Real Estate Campaign
projects.description:
Client: NITTY HOMES

The Problem: House hunting in Lagos is often exhausting, opaque, and full of stress.

The Story: This campaign walks the viewer through the entire buyer journey, from filtering verified homes and live video viewings to physical inspection, signing a clear agreement, and finally unlocking their new front door.

The Goal: Make the buyer's frustration feel familiar, then position Nitty Homes as the trusted, stress-free solution.

Concept Development • AI Video Production • Storytelling • Editing • Creative Direction

projects.title: Construction Technology
projects.description:
Client: QENVORA PROJECTS

The Problem: Most homeowners wait months for construction to finish before finding out if their home actually feels right.

The Story: We follow a homeowner from the fear of traditional building plans to walking through a full-scale hologram of their house on the actual land before a single block is laid.

The Goal: Show buyers that they never have to gamble on their dream home before construction begins.

Concept Development • AI Video Production • Storytelling • Creative Direction • Editing

projects.title: Academic Campaign
projects.description:
Client: NORVERIA ACADEMY

The Problem: Parents want their children ready for a fast-moving AI and tech world without losing wisdom and strong character.

The Story: Starting with a curious boy exploring his mother's phone, the film shows how a school can channel childhood curiosity into real-world readiness through mentorship, technology, and entrepreneurship seminars.

The Goal: Show parents a school that gives their child's natural curiosity clear direction.

Concept Development • AI Video Production • Storytelling • Creative Direction • Editing

projects.title: Brand Unveiling
projects.description:
Campaign: BRAND UNVEILING

The Problem: Most brands announce their launch with a static logo or plain flyer that people scroll past in two seconds.

The Story: A cinematic, story-led reveal built around anticipation, mood, and visual identity so viewers immediately feel the weight and personality of the brand from frame one.

The Goal: Turn a standard brand announcement into an unforgettable visual experience.

Concept Development • AI Video Production • Storytelling • Creative Direction • Editing

projects.title: Chauffeur Services
projects.description:
Campaign: EXECUTIVE CHAUFFEUR SERVICE

The Problem: Busy professionals do not just want a car ride; they want reliability, calm, and time back in their day.

The Story: This vertical campaign contrasts daily traffic stress with the quiet confidence of stepping into a professional, chauffeur-driven experience where every detail is handled.

The Goal: Position the service as an everyday luxury that gives clients back their peace of mind.

Concept Development • AI Video Production • Creative Direction • Storytelling • Editing

projects.title: Bridal Makeovers
projects.description:
Campaign: LUXURY BRIDAL MAKEOVERS

The Problem: Every bride shares the same quiet worry before her wedding day: wanting to look breathtaking without feeling like a stranger in her own skin.

The Story: Moving away from generic makeup transitions, this reel tells an emotional transformation story from quiet pre-wedding anticipation to the unforgettable moment she sees her final bridal glow.

The Goal: Build deep emotional trust so brides immediately see themselves in the experience.

Concept Development • AI Video Production • Creative Direction • Storytelling • Editing

projects.title: Wholesale Market Vendor
projects.description:
Client: WHOLESALE MARKET VENDOR

The Problem: Walking through a crowded open-air market under the heat, only to realize prices at stall after stall are inflated and unpredictable.

The Story: The video opens with the sensory exhaustion of market bargaining: the heat, the noise, the walking, and the frustration of prices doubling between stalls. Just as fatigue sets in, the shopper turns the corner and discovers the one verified wholesale vendor offering direct, transparent pricing on fresh essentials.

The Goal: Validate the shopper's real frustration first. Instead of generic market shouting, we show buyers that skipping the crowd and heading straight to this vendor is the smartest way to save both time and money.

Concept Development • AI Video Production • Creative Direction • Storytelling • Editing

projects.title: Book Promo
projects.description:
Campaign: THE C.A.R.E. METHOD

The Problem: Many businesses focus on closing sales while leaving customers with unanswered questions and costly mistakes.

The Story: Through Tunde’s gaming PC experience, this cinematic ad reveals the cost of missed conversations and the power of educating customers.

The Goal: Promote The C.A.R.E. Method: A Customer Service & Sales Playbook* by Ademulegun Opeoluwa, a practical guide explaining how to apply the C.A.R.E. Method and answering key questions about delivering better customer service and building lasting trust.

Concept Development • AI Video Production • Creative Direction • Storytelling • Cinematic Editing

projects.title: Nike Concept Heels
projects.description:
Campaign: NIKE AIR STILETTO (SPEC CONCEPT)

The Problem: Women in professional settings are forced to choose between looking sharp in formal high heels and enduring painful, rigid footwear for eight hours straight.

The Story: Sitting casually at home surrounded by her favorite Nike running shoes, a young professional candidly vents about the dreaded Monday morning boardroom walk, sparking a humorous, heartfelt plea for marathon-level cushioning inside formal stilettos.

The Goal: Demonstrate Anniestylez Media's ability to turn everyday consumer friction into viral, authentic UGC storytelling, proving that powerful advertising wins when it validates the customer's real pain before introducing a concept.

Concept Development • Creative Direction • Copywriting • AI Video Production • Social Storytelling
